name: As You Like Chanzuke Scenario with Songs
original_name: As you like ちゃん付けシナリオ with Songs
source:
Daigo has always been in love with childhood friend Kana, but she treats him only as a friend. During Tanabata festival he makes a wish to reunite with her one day. And Kana actually arrives to Daigo's school as a new English teacher and due to her circumstances stays at Daigo's house...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大悟一直深爱着青梅竹马加奈，但对方始终只把他当作朋友。七夕祭典期间，大悟许下愿望，希望有一天能与她重逢。后来，加奈竟真的来到大悟所在的学校担任新任英语教师，还因为个人原因住进了大悟家…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
